verdicts.reason: A is the better resize. It actually rearranges the design: the headline and CTA are large and easy to read at 300x250. Its flaws: the headline wraps so 'Light' sits alone on its second line, the CTA runs almost from edge to edge with thin side margins, the stack is cramped with little space between headline and CTA, and the sun mark shrinks to a dot with a tiny, barely legible 'SOLSTICE'. B is just a scaled-down copy of the original. The 'SOLSTICE' wordmark is unreadable, the CTA is tiny orange text, and the small headline leaves a lot of empty space around it, so it fails the readability and fit-to-format tests.
